results.description:
'I was immediately hooked…the slow burn tension between them is sizzling.' ★★★★

When fake becomes real, can two broken hearts risk it all?

Claire has spent the last couple of years building the perfect life for herself on the stunning Australian coast. But when she agrees to pose as the girlfriend of surfing sensation Bryce Maylands to help repair his public image, her carefully constructed walls begin to crumble…

Bryce may be known as a player, but his reputation is catching up with him. A fake relationship could be a lifeline – if he can keep his heart out of it, that is.

As tension builds, secrets surface and insecurities rise. Will they embrace the depths of their feelings or retreat to safety?

Perfect for fans of Elena Armas, Christina Lauren and Sally Thorne.

Reviews are in for Crashing Into You!

'What's not to like?… Just gorgeous… Had me smiling so much!' ★★★★★

'Perfect for anyone who loves emotional connections, great chemistry, and characters you can’t help but root for.' ★★★★

'A fun, easy summer romance that had me wishing I was on the Australian coast.' ★★★★

'Everything you could possibly want from the contemporary romance and sports fiction genres… an incredibly immersive, atmospheric world that completely stole my heart.' ★★★★

'A fast-paced, emotional, cozy beach read' ★★★★

Praise for Isadora Love…

'A proper romance… complete with kisses, sexy clothing and jealousy… a read-it-in-one-go late-into-the-night one!' ★★★★★

'An amazing enemies to lovers, workplace romance with drama and heartache and fun times mixed in' ★★★★★

''The perfect book for a beach read or a summer read… this one hit the mark with all of the tension and chemistry.' ★★★★

About the author

Isadora Love has travelled the world, lived in a few different places, and visited most of the surf locations featured in these books. (She might have kissed a surfer or two as well, but that's another story). When she's not writing, she likes to paint, travel, watch live music and hang out with her family and friends.

Isadora also writes fantasy romance under the name Helen Glynn Jones.
